title: Form fill in Brand Concierge
description: Emitted when a visitor submits a lead-capture form during a Brand Concierge session.

xdm:source.title: Source
xdm:source.description: Producing service for this form fill. Selects the downstream lead-resolution path.

meta:enum.LAS: Live Agent Service — consumer resolves the lead via the Marketo Integration Service upsert-lead call

xdm:bcSessionId.title: BC Session ID
xdm:bcSessionId.description: Brand Concierge session in which the form was submitted. Correlates the upserted lead to its session in the consumer.

xdm:leadEmail.title: Lead Email
xdm:leadEmail.description: Email address submitted on the form.

xdm:attributes.title: Form Attributes
xdm:attributes.description: Tenant-configured form fields as name/value pairs. Field names are tenant-defined and therefore not individually modelled.
